theme_central: A complete cycle: opening on the qualities of the successful believers, closing on the final supplication — a complete guide to what leads to true success.
sources_note: Sections 1-11 and 12-14 precisely sourced (al-islam.org, zamzamacademy.com). Rest reconstructed from well-established landmarks (Nuh 23-32, division into sects 53).

branches.title: Qualities of the successful believers
branches.resume: Humble prayer, detachment from the futile, zakat, chastity, promises kept.

children.t: Humble prayer, detachment from the futile, chastity, promises kept

branches.title: Creation of man, blessings
branches.resume: Stages of embryonic creation, the seven heavens, blessings of livestock and palm trees.

children.t: Stages of man's creation, then resurrection
The seven heavens, blessings of livestock, palm trees and olive trees

branches.title: Nuh and the succession of messengers
branches.resume: Nuh and the flood, then every community that calls its messenger a liar.

children.t: Nuh sent to his people, the ark, the flood
Succession of messengers rejected by their communities

branches.title: Musa, Aissa, division into sects
branches.resume: Musa and Harun sent to Pharaoh, Aissa a sign for mankind, division of religion into sects.

children.t: Musa and Harun sent to Pharaoh, rejection
Aissa and his mother, a sign for mankind; division into sects condemned

branches.title: True believers, reflecting on the Qur'an
branches.resume: Those who hasten toward good out of reverent fear; have they not reflected on the Qur'an?

children.t: Fearful believers hastening toward good; no soul burdened beyond its capacity
Have they not reflected on the Qur'an? Persistent blindness even when helped

branches.title: Allah, creator of the senses, refutation
branches.resume: Allah who created hearing, sight and hearts; refutation of a son or partners; request to return at the moment of death.

children.t: Allah, creator of the senses; rational argument against a son or partners
Refuge from the whisperings of devils; request to return refused at death

branches.title: Judgment, closing
branches.resume: No kinship ties that Day, fate of the damned, final supplication.

children.t: No kinship ties at the Judgment, fate of those who mocked the believers
Question about the duration of earthly life, final supplication: "forgive and have mercy"
